app.name: NTD-WATCH
app.subtitle: Community Health Intelligence
app.tagline: From community signals to timely public-health action.

banner.demo: DEMO DATA. Every record is synthetic.
banner.auth: Simulated login and roles. Not security controls.

landing.what: A community-level digital system that captures NTD-related symptoms and contextual risk factors, assesses potential risk using demonstration rules, supports referral and follow-up, and turns anonymised community data into GIS-based intelligence for health programmes.
landing.notDiagnosis: NTD-WATCH supports early recognition, triage, referral and programme decisions. It does not diagnose disease.
landing.chwBody: Mobile-first workflow: assess, see a demonstration risk result, refer, follow up.
landing.progBody: Responsive web dashboard for facility, LGA and state users, and the administrator.
landing.limitsTitle: What this prototype does not do

limits.outbreak: Declare outbreaks. Signals are investigation triggers.
limits.validated: Apply validated clinical rules. All rules are demonstration-only.
limits.real: Hold real patient data. All data is synthetic.
limits.integrations: Connect to DHIS2 or other systems.
